prerequisites: Supply reviewed base repository@sha256 digest and record exact preinstalled runtime/tool versions; no base selected or checksum invented.
No dependency installs are in the recipe; listed source operations use runtime standard-library tools only.
External tools need separately reviewed exact version locks and verified artifact hashes; unavailable operations are rejected, never emulated.
Recipe digest validation occurs after FROM and cannot authorize pulling/building; controller must validate base before an explicitly approved offline build.
Runtime must enforce network-none, non-root, readonly root, bounded noexec tmpfs, capability drop, no-new-privileges, wall/output/memory/pid limits and independent canaries.
No builds, fixture execution, container execution or isolation checks have been performed.

worker_interface.notes: Narrow controller mapping from validated typed request; no path/argv fields accepted. Output is untrusted observations, NOT ToolResult; host adds attested identities only after acceptance.
